CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH KUMAR ----

For the Petitioner(s)/Applicant(s) : Mr. Awanish Ranjan Mishra, Adv.
 For the State : Mrs. Kumari Rashmi, A.P.P.
 ----
 05/Dated: 17th January, 2024  1. Heard the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest, the applicant has approached this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail, in connection with Hazaribag Sadar P.S. Case No.72 of 2015, corresponding to G.R No.319 of 2015, registered for the offence under Sections 406, 420 & 34 of the Indian Penal Code,
pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Hazaribag.

entities.text: Hazaribag Sadar P.S. Case No.72 of 2015
entities.label: OTHER_PERSON

sentences.text: 3. Innocence of the applicant has been claimed and undertaking has been given for co-operating with the investigating agency and participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that the applicant is one of the guarantors.
Further, it has been submitted that the bank loan has been taken by the brother of this applicant.
The loan has not been repaid.
The loanee as well as the guarantor have already died.
Save and except being a guarantor, he has no role.
It has further been submitted that for non-repayment of the loan, this case has been lodged.
There is no allegation of any forgery.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.

5. Considering the above facts, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

Accordingly, the applicant is directed to surrender in the court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender, the court below shall enlarge the applicant on bail on his furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Hazaribag in connection with Hazaribag Sadar P.S.
